intro: Innkeeper Fredrik Farley manages the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, providing food, lodging, and hearthstones to travelers passing through Elwynn Forest. Well-liked and observant, he often holds misplaced mail and listens to the troubles of adventurers on the road.

p: The Farley family has operated the Lion's Pride Inn since the reign of King Llane Wrynn I. Alongside his wife Verina and their daughter Anna, Fredrik runs the establishment with a welcoming hand and a sharp eye. With large, sturdy hands well-suited to breaking up tavern brawls or expelling rowdy patrons, he keeps order in one of the realm's busiest waystations. Though his days are filled with pouring ale and serving cheese, he carries the private grief of losing his brother Frandis, a guard who perished in Lordaeron during the Scourge's plague.
